files.attempts.json: one row per graded attempt, with the memory write, the rewrite, any rejection and the ingest folded in. Derived from the jsonl; nothing new.
files.console.log: stdout of the run, if it was captured.
files.experiment.json: what the experiment was and how to read it.
files.skill-final.md: the procedure Cognee held when the run ended.
files.swarm-1789987670-metrics.json: the per-run summary the cross-run table is built from.
files.swarm-1789987670-series.json: the harness's own chart document: panels, annotations, axis decisions and a caveat per panel. deck/src/charts/Panel.tsx renders this and decides nothing itself.
files.swarm-1789987670.jsonl: every event, in order, with a `t` in seconds since the run started. The replayable record.
files.trees/: the package tree after every attempt, one tarball each. `closeness` and the v1 count can be recomputed from these.
files.DEMO-NOTES.md: THE DEMO RUN. Why this run, the full attempt table, why the racers are correct on it without intervention, and the four caveats that must not be papered over.

demo.headline: warm cleared 337 of 383 v1 surfaces with all 65 files compiling; cold cleared 160 and left 13 unimportable
demo.closeness_sign: warm positive on 9 of 10 attempts, cold negative on all 10 -- negative means further from the merged PR than the untouched checkout
